answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake that grows like a vine: one identity costs little, but every extra sock puppet needs its own bond, so a Sybil attacker pays linearly per fake while honest agents pay once. A rotating peer-review prism then scores real completed work and slashes the stake of identities caught faking output. A terrace of reputation tiers gates high-value jobs, so fresh fakes start at the bottom with nothing to gain, and climbing the terrace by burning stake costs more than any reward the attacker can extract.
